heroSub: FiveStar AI yi endla ti-utility ta iOS na ti-tool ta workflow. Hi humisa lava lava tsalaka—hi ku hatlisa na hi ku tshembeka.
rightSub: Ku endla xikombiso → Produkti → Ku hlayisa
m1Sub: MVP → Ku vutisa → Ku endla swa antsha
m2Sub: Ku txhamisa lokal, data yo vutana
m3Sub: Ku lulamisiwa lava file leti kulile na media

aboutLead: Hi herisa vukongomisi naswona hi rhuma swirhindla swo kongoma. Hi xeweta swiphiqo swa ntiyiso eka swivulavulo, xikombiso, na mfutukuteku wa ntirho.
missionTitle: Sungula hi switsongo, tsema hi sikulu
missionBody: Tiyisisa ku rhula. Aka xikongwana xyo ohla, u lava ku endla ntsutsumbi hi vutiviso.
principlesBody: UX yo kongiseka, mfutukuteku wa ntirho, data yo vala.
focusBody: OCR, ku hlawula PDF, ku tlangisa media, switeyiselo swa automation.
productsLead: Hi aka switirhisiwa swa xisolo swa vutomi bya ntiyiso.
p1: Workflow ya OCR ya maphepha ya skeniwe: hlawula, lava, kongisa, TTS—ku hlayisa xihundla hi ku tirhisa processing ya le hansi.
p2: Player ya video ya le hansi yo fufuka, yo kongisa. A ku na ma-ads. Ku hlangana kota kota na iOS.
p4: Software leyi hlanganaka na AI ya le hansi ku endla processing yo pfula na xinyoxanyo xa xihundla.
p5: Endla screenshots ta App Store ku va ntsongo ku hundzuluxa na ku endla localization hi rimi rin’wana na rin’wana ku lava ku humbelana.
p6: Xichat xa le kusuhi hi ku pfumelela ehenhla ka Bluetooth, ni vutirhiselo bya AI bya le hansi byo koka. A ku na akawunti, naswona a ku na savu ra xichat ra xikongomiso.
p7: Mufambiseli wa pass loyi a tivaka ndhawu. U vulavisa kuponi kumbe kadi ya vukombela leyi fanelelesekeke loko u fika.
p3: Swutirhisiwa swa le hansi swa mahanyelo ya App Store. Swi tsemisile ehenhla ka Swift/SwiftUI.
b2: AI ya le hansi na ku endla ntirho hi xivandla
b3: Ku tlangisa media na ku fambisa audio
q1: Ku hlola ka App Store na vutirhiselo bya xihundla
q2: Ku landzekisa crash na ku lawula swiphiqo
servicesLead: Ku hlamusela xiphiqo hi ku clear ku endlisa ku nyiketa.
s1Body: Vumelanani eka swikongomiso, metrics na swivandla.
s2Body: Humbisa MVP, vumisa hi ku tirhisiwa kwa ntiyiso.
s3Body: Hlawola na ku lungisela ku humbiswa.
contactLead: Kopiya templet leyi nge nhansi leswaku u hlamula hi ku hatlisa.
